text:
Mina: Quick follow-up from Cerulean private deployment postmortem — two clusters of work: VPC peering instability under replicate-heavy bursts, and an on-prem routing cleanup race that caused tenant isolation. Need owners + deadlines.
Ravi: I can own the peering stabilization. Will audit BGP timers, implement soft-restart behavior in our edge, and add packet-loss injection tests. ETA: 14 days. Created INF-2605: https://tracker.redwoodai/INF-2605
Sarah: I'll take connector resilience (agent restart/backoff + auto-rejoin smoke). Will add fault-injection e2e. ETA: 9 business days. Created INF-2606: https://tracker.redwoodai/INF-2606
Diego: I'll triage the routing cleanup race and add a regression in the integration harness. Small CAS change likely. ETA: 5 days. Created INF-2607: https://tracker.redwoodai/INF-2607
Mina: Action list short:
- Ravi (INF-2605): BGP hold-time tuning, soft-restart, customer guidance doc
- Sarah (INF-2606): agent restart policy, exponential backoff config, crash-recovery smoke test
- Diego (INF-2607): compare-and-swap on cleanup path, race regression test
- Luke/Ops: canary job + Grafana panel for asymmetric peering detection
Luke: I'll add the canary under infra/runbooks and a dashboard alert. ETA 2 business days.
Diego: Repro log from stress harness:
```
E 2025-06-03T11:12:07Z tenant-router cleanup: key not found
W 2025-06-03T11:12:07Z requeue cleanup task
E 2025-06-03T11:12:07Z concurrent cleanup detected tenant=cerulean-17
```
Diego: Plan: guard cleanup with CAS and assert idempotency in integration case.
Sarah: Connector plan: add config toggles for backoff, a restart policy, and a smoke test that kills the agent container and verifies rejoin within SLA.
Ravi: Peering plan: tune bgp hold-time, add soft-restart, and document recommended timers for customer routers. Will run a flaky-network test with 100ms loss for 60s.
Mina: Org items: 1) add INF-2605/2606/2607 to Dedicated/Postmortem board, 2) start monthly "isolation rotation" for eng-sre triage ownership.
Sarah: I'll draft the rotation roster and post by Friday EOD.
Ops-bot: Reminder set for #incidents weekly 09:00 UTC — "Isolation trends triage".
Laura: I'll add a replicate-heavy synthetic to the dedicated perf harness mirroring Cerulean's pattern. ETA 10 days.
Mina: Good. Please paste PR links and changelogs here when ready. We'll send Cerulean a private addendum with the verification window after INF-2607 deploys. Thanks all :tada:
